Description_and_limits: Excluded from predictors; required to be complete and unique.
Borrower age; source name indicates age. Unit should be checked against source documentation.
Borrower income; currency and measurement period not established in the archived source.
Loan amount; currency not established in the archived source.
Credit score; scoring system not documented here.
Employment duration in months, as indicated by the field name.
Interest rate; percentage versus decimal encoding must be verified from source.
Scheduled loan term; not observed time to default. Unit must be verified from source.
Debt-to-income ratio; calculation and encoding must be verified from source.
Education category; levels read from the input file.
Employment category; levels read from the input file.
Marital status; levels read from the input file.
Mortgage indicator; encoding read from the input file.
Dependents indicator; encoding read from the input file.
Loan purpose; levels read from the input file.
Co-signer indicator; encoding read from the input file.
0 = nondefault, 1 = default; complete 0/1 coding required. Outcome horizon is undocumented.
